name: pre-edit-strict-path-under-an-ignore-pattern-stays-strict
description: #261: strict wins over ignore. With .coherence/ignored.yaml listing the strict path itself (a leftover ignore entry, present at spawn; the harness writes unquoted YAML, so a '*'-led glob would parse as an alias), a tracked strict path is still tracked and strict: the stale pre-edit denies exactly as in fixture 05 instead of taking the untracked fast path, where a read reports version 0 and a CAS commit is accepted at any expected_version (a silent lost update). Python only: the Node coordinator's policy evaluator lives in the plugin repository (not in this tree) and still lets ignore win, so this fixture is the parity target for that follow-up rather than a Node row that would fail.
